name: Mimosa Access_point (MIB)
description: Auto-compiled with libsmi from 4 MIB module(s). 149 readable OIDs under 1.3.6.1.4.1.43356.

oids.name: mimosaTrapMessage
oids.description: General Octet String object to contain message sent with traps.

oids.name: mimosaOldSpeed
oids.description: The speed of the Ethernet link before the change within Ethernet Speed Change Notifications.

oids.name: mimosaNewSpeed
oids.description: The speed of the Ethernet link after the change within Ethernet Speed Change Notifications.

oids.name: mimosaDeviceName
oids.description: The name of the local Mimosa device. This unique identifier could be the same as the sysName object.

oids.name: mimosaSerialNumber
oids.description: The unique serial number of the Mimosa device.

oids.name: mimosaFirmwareVersion
oids.description: The version of the currently installed and/or running firmware on the Mimosa device.

oids.name: mimosaFirmwareBuildDate
oids.description: The creation date of the currently installed and/or running firmware on the Mimosa device.

oids.name: mimosaLastRebootTime
oids.description: The last time the Mimosa device rebooted.

oids.name: mimosaUnlockCode
oids.description: The code used to unlock the Mimosa device.

oids.name: mimosaLEDBrightness
oids.description: Indicates the intensity of the status indicator lights on the device exterior. The Auto option adjusts the amount of light based upon ambient conditions. Manual options include Low, Medium, and High.

oids.name: mimosaInternalTemp
oids.description: The internal temperature of the Mimosa device.

oids.name: mimosaRegulatoryDomain
oids.description: The country in which the Mimosa device has been configured to run.

oids.name: mimosaRebootReason
oids.description: Displays the reason of the last reboot of the Mimosa device

oids.name: mimosaLongitude
oids.description: The Longitude of the Mimosa device location, in 5 decimal points.

oids.name: mimosaLatitude
oids.description: The Latitude of the Mimosa device location, in 5 decimal points.

oids.name: mimosaAltitude
oids.description: The Altitude of the Mimosa device location in meters.

oids.name: mimosaSatelliteSNR
oids.description: The average Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR) amongst all of the satellites detected by the Mimosa device. Display is in 1 decimal point.

oids.name: mimosaSatelliteStrength
oids.description: Strength of the satellites based on the number of satellites available. It is considered good if more than 2 satellites are available.

oids.name: mimosaGPSSatellites
oids.description: Total number of GPS satellites detected.

oids.name: mimosaGlonassSatellites
oids.description: Total number of GLONASS satellites detected.

oids.name: mimosaClockAccuracy
oids.description: Timing signal accuracy measured in parts per billion (PPB) by the Mimosa device. Display is in 2 decimal points.

oids.name: mimosaWanSsid
oids.description: The wireless link name used by both radios. Both AP and Station must use the same SSID to communicate with each other.

oids.name: mimosaWanMac
oids.description: The MAC address used for the wireless link.

oids.name: mimosaWanStatus
oids.description: The wireless link status between the Mimosa devices.

oids.name: mimosaWanUpTime
oids.description: The wireless link up time since last reboot.

oids.name: mimosaWirelessMode
oids.description: Describes wherger the Mimosa device acts as an access point or station.

oids.name: mimosaWirelessProtocol
oids.description: Describes the wireless protocol configured on the Mimosa device. Both TDMA and CSMA are supported. TDMA is a deterministic protocol where each device is assigned a time slot during which it is allo...

oids.name: mimosaTDMAMode
oids.description: Specifies the TDMA Gender of the radio (A or B).

oids.name: mimosaTDMAWindow
oids.description: Specifies the length of the transmit time slot in milliseconds.

oids.name: mimosaTrafficSplit
oids.description: The radio can be configured to allocate bandwidth symmetrically (50/50) or asymmetrically (75/25 or 25/75) in environments where traffic direction is expected to be heavier in one direction than th...

oids.name: mimosaNetworkMode
oids.description: Specifies the mode for the local 2.4 GHz wireless network operation. If Auto is selected, the 2.4 GHz management network is turned on for a limited time (defined in Console Timeout ) after boot and...

oids.name: mimosaRecoverySsid
oids.description: The recovery SSID that allows the device to be reset to factory defaults. This is available for 10 minutes after device boot. Disabling the 2.4 GHz management network will not impact availability o...

oids.name: mimosaLocalSsid
oids.description: The SSID for managing the local 2.4 GHz wireless interface.

oids.name: mimosaLocalChannel
oids.description: The channel used for the local 2.4 GHz wireless interface.

oids.name: mimosaConsoleTimeout
oids.description: The amount inactivity on the 2.4 GHz wireless interface before turning it off in Auto mode.

oids.name: mimosaMaxClients
oids.description: The maximum number of wireless clients that can simultaneously access the 2.4 GHz management interface.

oids.name: mimosaLocalMac
oids.description: The MAC address used for 2.4 GHz wireless link.

oids.name: mimosaLocalIpAddr
oids.description: The IP address assigned to the 2.4 GHz wireless link.

oids.name: mimosaLocalNetMask
oids.description: The IP netmask assigned to the 2.4 GHz wireless link.

oids.name: mimosaLocalGateway
oids.description: The IP address of the gateway for the 2.4 GHz wireless link.

oids.name: mimosaFlowControl
oids.description: Specifies whether Flow Control is enabled on the Mimosa device.

oids.name: mimosaTxPower
oids.description: Specifies the transmit power of the given RF chain. A value of -8 means this particular TxChain is not a valid entry.

oids.name: mimosaRxPower
oids.description: Specifies the receive power of the given RF chain. A value of -100 means this particular RxChain is not a valid entry (SNR must be -100).

oids.name: mimosaRxNoise
oids.description: Specifies the received noise level for the given RF chain.

oids.name: mimosaSNR
oids.description: Indicates the Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR) for the given RF chain. A value of -100 means this particular RxChain is not a valid entry.

oids.name: mimosaCenterFreq
oids.description: The center frequency for the given RF chain. A value of 0 means this particular Chain is not a valid entry.

oids.name: mimosaPolarization
oids.description: The ploarization of the given RF chain. It could be horizontal or vertical.

oids.name: mimosaTxPhy
oids.description: Specifies the transmit rate of the given data stream.

oids.name: mimosaTxMCS
oids.description: Specifies the transmit MCS of the given data stream. A value of -1 means this particular TxStream is not a valid entry.

oids.name: mimosaTxWidth
oids.description: Specifies the channel width based on MCS. A value of -1 means this particular TxWidth is not a valid entry

oids.name: mimosaRxPhy
oids.description: Specifies the receive rate of the given data stream.

oids.name: mimosaRxMCS
oids.description: Specifies the receive MCS of the given data stream. A value of -1 means this particular RxStream is not a valid entry.

oids.name: mimosaRxWidth
oids.description: Specifies the receive Rx Width of the given data stream. A value of -1 means this particular RxWidth is not a valid entry.

oids.name: mimosaRxEVM
oids.description: Specifies the receive Error Vector Magnitude (EVM) of the given data stream.

oids.name: mimosaChannelMode
oids.description: Specifies the mode for the given channel. The transmit or receive values indicate Frequency Diversity (FD) mode is in use. The bidirectional value means that the channel is used for both transmit a...

oids.name: mimosaChannelWidth
oids.description: Specifies the channel width of the given channel.

oids.name: mimosaChannelTxPower
oids.description: Specifies the transmit power level on the channel. If Channel Width is set to 1xN MHz, Channel 2 is not be used. In Frequency Diversity mode, Power 1 and Power 2 represent transmit power on the loc...

oids.name: mimosaChannelCenterFreq
oids.description: Specifies the center frequency of the channel used on the link. In all modes, the center frequency represents the absolute center of the selected channel width without any offset, and the center ca...

oids.name: mimosaAntennaGain
oids.description: The antenna gain on the Mimosa device.

oids.name: mimosaTotalTxPower
oids.description: The total transmit power for all the channels on the Mimosa device.

oids.name: mimosaTotalRxPower
oids.description: The total receive power for all the channels on the Mimosa device.

oids.name: mimosaTargetSignalStrength
oids.description: The calculated target receive signal strength based on device coordinates and settings.

oids.name: mimosaPhyTxRate
oids.description: The transmit packet rate at the physical level over a 5 second interval.

oids.name: mimosaPhyRxRate
oids.description: The receive packet rate at the physical level over a 5 second interval.

oids.name: mimosaPerTxRate
oids.description: The trasnmit Packet Error Rate (PER) over a 5 second interval. It is caluculated as packets with errors versuss packets without errors.

oids.name: mimosaPerRxRate
oids.description: The receive Packet Error Rate (PER) over a 5 second interval. It is caluculated as packets with errors versuss packets without errors.

oids.name: mimosaHttpsEnabled
oids.description: Specifies whether HTTPS is enabled on the Mimosa device.

oids.name: mimosaMgmtVlanEnabled
oids.description: Specifies whether the Management VLAN is enabled on the Mimosa device.

oids.name: mimosaMgmtCloudEnabled
oids.description: Specifies whether the Management Cloud is enabled on the Mimosa device.

oids.name: mimosaRestMgmtEnabled
oids.description: Specifies whether the REST management is enabled on the Mimosa device.

oids.name: mimosaPingWatchdogEnabled
oids.description: Specifies whether the IP Ping watchdog is enabled on the Mimosa device. This is used to reset the device if a configured IP address is not reached in certain number of retries.

oids.name: mimosaSyslogEnabled
oids.description: Specifies whether the Syslog client is enabled on the Mimosa device. Syslog client sends the log messages to configured syslog server.

oids.name: mimosaNtpMode
oids.description: Specifies whether the NTP client is configured to use standard servers from NIST, NTP organizations or custom NTP server.

oids.name: mimosaNtpServer
oids.description: Specifies the name or address of the custom NTP server.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpSsidName
oids.description: Describes the name of the SSID

oids.name: mimosaPtmpSsidType
oids.description: Describes the type of clients that will connect to this SSID. CPE represents fixed, or Hotspot represents mobile devices

oids.name: mimosaPtmpSsidEnabled
oids.description: Describes if the SSID is enabled (True) or disabled (False)

oids.name: mimosaPtmpSsidBroadcastEnabled
oids.description: Describes if the Broadcast feature for this SSID is enabled or disabled

oids.name: mimosaPtmpSsidIsolationEnabled
oids.description: Describes if the client isolation is enabled or disabled

oids.name: mimosaPtmpWirelessMode
oids.description: Describes the wireless protocol configured on the Mimosa Device

oids.name: mimosaPtmpWirelessGender
oids.description: Describes the wireless protocol gender that defines the transmit and receive timing

oids.name: mimosaPtmpWirelessTrafficSplit
oids.description: Describes how the bandwidth is split between the AP and Station

oids.name: mimosaPtmpWirelessWindowLength
oids.description: Describes the length of the transmit time slot in milliseconds

oids.name: mimosaPtmpAutoChannelEnabled
oids.description: Describes if the Auto Channel feature is Enabled or Disabled. This function selects the channel that results in the best RF performance.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpAntennaGain
oids.description: Describes the antenna gain for connectorized version of the device. Measured in dBi.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpChPwrRadioName
oids.description: Describes the name of the radio.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpChPwrCntrFreqCfg
oids.description: Describes the configured center frequency of the channel used on the access point. The center frequency represents the absolute center of the selected channel width without any offset. Measured in MHz

oids.name: mimosaPtmpChPwrPrimChannelCfg
oids.description: Describes the primary channel number that corresponds with the operating frequency.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpChPwrChWidthCfg
oids.description: Describes the channel width for access point operation: 20 MHz, 40 MHz or 80 MHz

oids.name: mimosaPtmpChPwrTxPowerCfg
oids.description: Describes the desired transmit power level. The allowed options are determined by a combination of country and chosen frequency. Measured in dBm

oids.name: mimosaPtmpChPwrCntrFreqCur
oids.description: Describes the current center frequency of the channel used on the access point. The center frequency represents the absolute center of the selected channel width without any offset. Measured in MHz

oids.name: mimosaPtmpChPwrPrimChannelCur
oids.description: Describes the current primary channel number that corresponds with the operating frequency.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpChPwrChWidthCur
oids.description: Describes the current channel width for access point operation: 20 MHz, 40 MHz or 80 MHz

oids.name: mimosaPtmpChPwrTxPowerCur
oids.description: Describes the current transmit power level. The allowed options are determined by a combination of country and chosen frequency. Measured in dBm

oids.name: mimosaPtmpChPwrAgcMode
oids.description: Describes the setting for Automatic Gain Control (AGC) feature, which is used to set the signal level below which the radio ignores incoming RF interference. The choices are Off or Manual

oids.name: mimosaPtmpChPwrMinRxPower
oids.description: Describes the Rx power level (in manual AGC Mode) below your expected signal, but above other interference, measured in dBm

oids.name: mimosaPtmpChannelExclusionStart
oids.description: Describes the lower limit for the exclusion range, not including this frequency

oids.name: mimosaPtmpChannelExclusionEnd
oids.description: Describes the upper limit for the exclusion range, not including this frequency.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpApStatsRxBytes
oids.description: Describes the number of bytes received by the AP in single-User mode

oids.name: mimosaPtmpApStatsTxBytes
oids.description: Describes the number of bytes transmitted by the AP in single-user mode

oids.name: mimosaPtmpApStatsRxPkts
oids.description: Describes the number of packets received by the AP in single-user mode

oids.name: mimosaPtmpApStatsTxPkts
oids.description: Describes the number of packets transmitted by the AP in single-user mode

oids.name: mimosaPtmpApStatsTxPer
oids.description: Describes the packet error rate on the transmit path of the AP, in single-user mode

oids.name: mimosaPtmpApStatsLastUpdated
oids.description: Describes the last updated time for these statistics

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientInfoMacAddress
oids.description: Describes the MAC address of the client associated to this access- point.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientName
oids.description: Describes the name associated with this client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientFWVersion
oids.description: Describes the firmware version of this client. This is supported only if the client is a Mimosa device.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientIPAddress
oids.description: Describes the IP Address associated with this client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientAssociatedTime
oids.description: Describes how long the client is associated with this access-point.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientPlanName
oids.description: Describes the Traffic Shaping plan associated with this client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientUlCommitted
oids.description: Describes the Uplink Committed Rate configured for the client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientUlPeak
oids.description: Describes the Uplink Peak Rate configured for the client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientDlCommitted
oids.description: Describes the Downlink Committed Rate configured for the client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientDlPeak
oids.description: Describes the Downlink Peak Rate configured for the client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientInfoLastUpdated
oids.description: Describes the last updated time of this information for the Client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientStatsMacAddress
oids.description: Describes the MAC address of the client associated to this access- point.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientAssocBW
oids.description: Describes the associated bandwidth of the client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientRxBytes
oids.description: Describes the number of bytes received from this client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientTxBytes
oids.description: Describes the number of bytes transmitted to this client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientRxPkts
oids.description: Describes the number of packets received from this client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientTxPkts
oids.description: Describes the number of packets transmitted to this client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientRxPhyRate
oids.description: Describes the receive rate of this client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientTxPhyRate
oids.description: Describes the transmit rate of this client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientTxAvgPer
oids.description: Describes the average packet error rate on the transmit side for this client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientRssiAvg
oids.description: Describes the average RSSI for this Client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientStatsLastUpdated
oids.description: Describes the last updated time of this information for the Client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientRssi1
oids.description: Describes the RSSI of chain 1 for this Client. Measured in dBm

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientRssi2
oids.description: Describes the RSSI of chain 2 for this Client. Measured in dBm

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientRssi3
oids.description: Describes the RSSI of chain 3 for this Client. Measured in dBm

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientRssi4
oids.description: Describes the RSSI of chain 4 for this Client. Measured in dBm

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientRxEVM1
oids.description: Describes the RxEVM of stream 1 for this Client. Measured in dB

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientRxEVM2
oids.description: Describes the RxEVM of stream 2 for this Client. Measured in dB

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientRxEVM3
oids.description: Describes the RxEVM of stream 3 for this Client. Measured in dB

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientRxEVM4
oids.description: Describes the RxEVM of stream 4 for this Client. Measured in dB

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientRxNss
oids.description: Describes the for this Client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientTxNss
oids.description: Describes the for this Client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientRxMcs
oids.description: Describes the for this Client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientTxMcs
oids.description: Describes the for this Client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpClientSNR
oids.description: Describes the SNR for this Client.

oids.name: mimosaPtmpMgmtIpAddress
oids.description: Describes the IP Address configured on the Mimosa Device

oids.name: mimosaPtmpMgmtIpNetmask
oids.description: Describes the IP netmask configured on the Mimosa Device

oids.name: mimosaPtmpMgmtIpGateway
oids.description: Describes the IP Address of the Gateway configured on the Mimosa Device

oids.name: mimosaPtmpMgmtIpMode
oids.description: Describes the IP Address assignment mode configured on the Mimosa Device

oids.name: mimosaPtmpMgmtPrimaryDNS
oids.description: Describes the IP Address of the Primary DNS server configured on the Mimosa Device

oids.name: mimosaPtmpMgmtSecondaryDNS
oids.description: Describes the IP Address of the Secondary DNS server configured on the Mimosa Device

oids.name: mimosaPtmpMgmtVlanStatus
oids.description: Describes the status of management vlan configured on the Mimosa Device

oids.name: mimosaPtmpMgmtVlanId
oids.description: Describes the management vlan-id configured on the Mimosa Device

oids.name: mimosaPtmpMgmtVlanPassthrough
oids.description: Describes the status of the vlan passthrough configured on the Mimosa Device

oids.name: mimosaPtmpMgmtEthernetMac
oids.description: Describes the Ethernet MAC address configured on the Mimosa Device
